Development Timeline

Phased development plan for the Circular Enterprises platform across Hudson Valley.

Jan 2025

Phase I — Predevelopment Begins

Restaurant concept, design & entitlement. Site plan approval and preview events underway.

Dec 2026

Phase I Financing Closing

LP equity and restaurant construction debt close ($10.3M Phase I capital, $4.66M equity).

Jan 2027 – Sep 2027

Land Acquisition

Restaurant parcel and resort land contribution close Jan 2027; residences parcels ($3,021,000) acquired Jan 2027 – Sep 2027.

Feb 2027 – May 2027

Restaurant Demo, Excavation & Permit

Site demolition and excavation, followed by building permit issuance.

May 2027 – Oct 2027

Restaurant Construction

Structure, envelope, MEP, kitchen build-out and interior fit-out.

Nov 2027 – Dec 2027

Restaurant CofO & Soft Opening

Certificate of occupancy and soft opening of Wren of the Woods.

Jan 2028

Restaurant Grand Opening

Wren of the Woods opens to the public (90 seats). Year 1 sales $3.94M; stabilized prime cost ~65.8%.

Jul 2027 – Sep 2027

Phase II & III Capital Raise

Resort and residences capital closes: Phase II $80.7M ($27.8M equity, USDA B&I + C-PACE); Phase III $42.6M ($14.3M equity).

Feb 2027 – Jan 2028

Resort Entitlements & Permits

Sketch plan, preliminary and final plat, public hearing, and building permit.

Oct 2027 – May 2028

Farm Operations Begin

Agroforestry, animal husbandry and agritourism programming begin on-site.

Feb 2028 – Jan 2029

Resort Construction

Sitework & infrastructure and trails, then hotel, barn, cabins and greenhouse.

Jul 2027 – Dec 2028

Residences Predevelopment & Sitework

Entitlement, sitework and infrastructure for 20 villas + 10 townhomes.

May 2029

Resort Grand Opening

Livingston Farm resort (70 keys) opens following a Apr 2029 soft opening. Year 1 occupancy ~44.8%, ADR $944, RevPAR $423. Year 1 revenue ~$15.0M.

2029

Farm Break-Even

Farm operations reach break-even with $211K revenue and $152K OpEx. Net income turns positive at $58K.

Jan 2029 – Mar 2030

Residences Homebuilding & Sellout

All 30 units sold and delivered. Gross sales $59.9M, all-in cost $36.6M, 28.9% net margin.

2031

Resort Stabilization

Resort at 64.8% occupancy, $1,109 ADR, $718 RevPAR. Revenue $24.8M, NOI $10.4M (~$149K/key, 42% margin).

2032 – 2035

Stabilized Operations & Exit

Continued 3% ADR growth. Platform levered IRR 61.1%, unlevered 25.0%, drawn EM 3.71x. Capital event Dec 2035.
